subject: 6th Grade Track & Field Day - Saturday, May 30
text_body:
Dear 6th Grade Families,

Our annual 6th Grade Track & Field Day is coming up on Saturday, May 30, 2026! This is a fun-filled day of athletic events where students get to showcase their skills and sportsmanship.

SCHEDULE OF EVENTS
Location: Lincoln Elementary School Field

9:00 AM - Check-in and warm-up
9:30 AM - Opening ceremonies and team announcements
10:00 AM - Event rotations begin
  - 50m dash
  - 100m dash
  - 400m run
  - Long jump
  - Shot put
  - Relay races (4x100m)
12:00 PM - Lunch break (hot dogs, watermelon, and drinks provided)
12:45 PM - Final events and relay finals
1:30 PM - Awards ceremony
2:00 PM - Conclusion

WHAT STUDENTS NEED:
- Athletic clothes and running shoes (no sandals or boots)
- Sunscreen (apply before arriving)
- Water bottle with their name on it
- Hat or visor recommended
- Spirit! Wear your Lincoln Lion colors (blue and gold)

PARENTS WELCOME!
Come cheer on your athlete! Spectator seating will be available along the field. Feel free to bring lawn chairs or blankets for seating on the grass.

No RSVP needed - all 6th graders automatically participate. If your child cannot attend, please let me know by Thursday, May 28.

Looking forward to a great day!

Coach Jim Patterson
Physical Education Teacher
Lincoln Elementary School
